A 68-year-old man presents for evaluation by a neurologist for an involuntary hand tremor that started approximately 3 months ago.
His temperature is 98.6°F (37.0°C), blood pressure is 115/70 mmHg, pulse is 70/min, and respirations are 12/min.
The tremor extinguishes with voluntary movement.
